title: Generalized Feynman Graph Expansions for Lévy-Driven Pseudo-Differential Evolution Equations
summary: We study a class of Cauchy problems driven by pseudo-differential operators with Lévy-type symbols. We extend earlier results from exponential initial data to a broader set of initial conditions. We demonstrate the existence and uniqueness of the solution, which has an explicit convolution representation with the associated kernel. We then derive an asymptotic expansion of the solution, with coefficients expressed in terms of moments and, after taking logarithms, in terms of cumulants.
